sources.snippet: These chains, along with their associated text chunks, are then integrated into the generation prompt to explicitly guide the model's reasoning process. Importantly, SARG doesn't require custom retrievers or domain-specific fine-tuning. Instead, it functions as a modular layer compatible with all existing RAG pipelines.

sources.snippet: Moreover, SARG adopts a machine learning approach, enabling model generalization, which allows it to effectively predict resiliency for unseen software applications. The experimental results show that SARG achieves 43 % higher prediction accuracy than the state-of-the-art ML-based approach while being 3 times faster.
